source_caption_text:
21 Savage is still a real one for this 🙏💯

21 Savage and Metro Boomin set the tone for SAVAGE MODE II with “Runnin” 🔥🎧

Released on October 2, 2020, the track captures what makes their partnership so effective: Metro builds an eerie atmosphere, while 21 delivers his verses with a calm, measured confidence. The contrast between the soulful sample and heavy drums gives the song its unmistakable sound. 

That sample comes from Diana Ross’ 1976 song “I Thought It Took a Little Time (But Today I Fell in Love).” Metro transforms the original into a haunting loop, creating a backdrop that leaves plenty of room for 21’s voice. It’s a memorable example of how a sample can take on a completely different mood in another artist’s hands. 

“Runnin” reached No. 9 on the Billboard Hot 100, becoming another top-10 hit for the duo. It arrived four years after their original Savage Mode project, continuing a partnership that had already produced fan favorites and helped establish both artists as major forces in Atlanta rap.
